deleteWarning: Delete this template? Existing adapters will remain unchanged.
sensitiveWarning: Check code, ordinary parameters and selected inputs for customer information. Credentials, tokens and source bindings are excluded, but not all secrets can be detected automatically.
unsavedWarning: There are unsaved changes. This uses the latest saved configuration snapshot and does not save your edits.
galleryWarning: Templates are visible to users with access to this deployment’s gallery. Check code, parameters and examples for information that should not be shared.
file: Choose a DLR ZIP package (up to 16 MiB)
includeFiles: Explicitly include selected managed input files
previewNote: Choose a file to review and adjust its contents, then import. Duplicate names receive a numbered suffix.
name: Name
pendingParameters: Parameter names to fill after import
pendingNote: Pending parameters are removed from runtime values without inserting placeholders. After supplying a value, remove its name from this list.
runtimeSettings: Runtime and trigger settings (stopped after import)
inputOmitted: Omitted; confirm in the target environment
examplesNote: Only add sanitized examples that may be shared. Examples are not automatically bound as production inputs.
targetWarning: The new adapter starts with schedules disabled and Webhook reception stopped at a new path. Reconfirm addresses, inputs, credentials and Worker. Import success does not mean it is ready to run correctly.
workerRequired: The first Task save requires a target Worker supporting its language.
confirmShared: I reviewed code, parameters and examples and confirm sharing this content in the current deployment's template gallery.
confirmReviewed: I reviewed this preview and understand the target environment still needs configuration.
adapterCreated: Adapter created and stopped. Review its configuration reminders and configure the target environment before running.
failed: Operation failed. Check permissions, target file capability and capacity, then retry.
nameConflict: This name already exists. Rename and retry.
versionConflict: The template changed. Close and reopen the latest version.
tooLarge: Package or attachments exceed limits (16 MiB ZIP, 32 MiB expanded, up to 9 attachments).
workerError: The target Worker is missing or does not support this language. Select again.
filesUnavailable: Managed input files or storage are unavailable in the target environment. Configure them first.
saveFirst: Save an adapter version before exporting.
invalidPackage: Invalid package, unsupported format or wrong object type. Choose the correct adapter/template ZIP.
invalidJson: Parameters and examples must be valid JSON objects.
configurationNotes: This adapter came from portable content. Check target inputs, credentials and addresses. Pending parameters: {{parameters}}; input omitted during import: {{input}}.
autoRename: Duplicate names receive an automatic (1), (2), … suffix on import.
